# agent-colours

Colours subagent and skill names in Claude Code by their own color: field. An agent's name sits on a coloured badge in its Agent row and in replies; a skill's name is drawn in its colour in its Skill row and in replies. Alpha: a function-hooks mod; it ships no commands or skills of its own.

## Install

```bash
magus
```

Find `agent-colours` on the Plugins tab and turn it on. magus registers the `magus-alpha`
marketplace if you do not have it, and installs what the plugin needs to actually run —
binaries, MCP servers, CLI tools.

For a team, press `s` to save your plugins as a profile and commit it. Everyone else runs
`magus install` — see [Teams and profiles](../../guides/teams.md).

Prefer to do it by hand? [Installing Magus](../../guides/install.md) has the manual path.

## Hooks

This plugin installs hooks. They run automatically and are the usual first place to look
if its behaviour stops firing.
